name: sonoffice-erp
description: Sonoffice ERP — monorepo (apps/web React+Vite+TS+Tailwind · apps/api NestJS+TS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @sonoffice/api" "npm run dev -w @sonoffice/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sonoffice/api && npm run build -w @sonoffice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sonoffice/api && npm run typecheck -w @sonoffice/web
